map.RC4 加密解密。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: RC4 encrypt/decrypt. An online tool built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
map.：KSA 阶段用密钥打乱 256 项 S 盒，PRGA 阶段逐字节生成密钥流与数: : The KSA phase scrambles a 256-entry S-box with the key; the PRGA phase generates the keystream byte-by-byte and XORs it with the data.
map.：实现简单、速度快，曾用于 WEP 与早期 TLS。: : Simple to implement and fast; once used in WEP and early TLS.
map.：密钥流存在统计偏差，且 WEP 因 IV 重用被轻易破解，现已被废弃。: : The keystream has statistical biases, and WEP was easily broken due to IV reuse; it is now deprecated.
map.：应使用 AES-GCM 或 ChaCha20-Poly1305 等带认证的加密: : Use authenticated encryption such as AES-GCM or ChaCha20-Poly1305 instead.
map.是一种流加密算法，由Ron Rivest设计。广泛用于SSL/TLS（早期）、W: is a stream cipher designed by Ron Rivest, widely used in early SSL/TLS, WEP/WPA, etc.
map.⚠️ 注意：RC4已被证明存在安全漏洞，建议仅用于兼容旧系统，不要用于新的安全场: ⚠️ Note: RC4 has proven security vulnerabilities; use it only for legacy-system compatibility, not for new security scenarios. Supports the RC4-drop (skip first n bytes) variant.
map.📚 深度解析：RC4 / ARC4 加密解密: 📚 Deep Dive: RC4 / ARC4 Encrypt & Decrypt
map.轻量流密码，仅用于兼容历史协议。: A lightweight stream cipher, used only for legacy-protocol compatibility.
map.维护老协议兼容：某些遗留系统仍在用 RC4，需要按同样算法加解密才能对接——但新: Maintaining legacy-protocol compatibility: some old systems still use RC4 and need the same algorithm to interoperate—but new systems should never adopt it.
map.RC4 以密钥调度生成伪随机流与明文异或；因偏弱偏（前若干字节有偏）已被弃用。: RC4 uses key scheduling to generate a pseudo-random stream XORed with the plaintext; it is deprecated due to weak bias (the first few bytes are biased).
map.新系统不建议，优先 AES-GCM/ChaCha20。: Not recommended for new systems; prefer AES-GCM/ChaCha20.
map.RC4 具体有什么问题？: What exactly is wrong with RC4?
map.三点：一是密钥调度存在偏差，密文前若干字节的统计特性会泄露密钥信息（Fluhre: Three points: first, key scheduling has biases—the statistical properties of the first few ciphertext bytes leak key information (the Fluhrer–Mantin–Shamir attack, used to break WEP); second, many known invariants and weak keys; third, no standard for IV usage, so reusing the keystream allows decryption. RFC 7465 explicitly prohibits RC4 in TLS.
